question: Indian musician Jagjit Singh is credited for the revival of ______ genre of music / poetry.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghazal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagjit Singh:-**

 
 
• He was born on February 8, 1941, in Lahore, Punjab. 
 
• He received his bachelor's degree in English literature from Delhi University.
 
• **Jagjit Singh is credited for the revival of the ghazal genre of music and poetry. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• Jagjit Singh has been awarded numerous awards for his singing, including the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and National Awards. He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2002.
 
• ​Some of his most famous ghazals include:
 
 
• Aaj Phir Tumko Dekha To
 
• Tumse Milne Ko Jee Chahta Hai
 
• Dil Mein Tu Hai
 
• Mere Dil Mein Tum Hi Ho
 
• Woh Kaun Si Gali Hai
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghazals:-**

 
 
• These are a form of lyric poetry originating in the Arabic-speaking world.
 
• They are typically short poems, consisting of five to fifteen rhyming couplets.
 
• Each couplet is independent, but the ghazal as a whole has a thematic unity.
 
• Ghazals often deal with themes of love, longing, separation, and the pain of loss.
 
 
 
• **Sufism:-**
 
 
• It is a mystical tradition within Islam.
 
• It emphasizes introspection, spiritual closeness with God, and the purification of the soul.
 
• Sufis seek to achieve direct personal experience of God through a variety of practices, including prayer, meditation, and chanting.
 
 
 
• **Jazz:-**
 
 
• It is a music genre that originated in the African-American communities of New Orleans, Louisiana, in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, with its roots in blues and ragtime.
 
• Jazz is characterized by swing and blue notes, complex chords, call and response vocals, polyrhythms and improvisation. Jazz has roots in European harmony and African rhythmic rituals.
